_comment_objective: Find VALID user personas that drive the GPT-5.4 agent's tau2-bench success rate as low as possible. Lower avg_success_rate = harder = better.
target_flavor: FREE EXPLORATION — any realistic, valid difficult customer that makes the task harder for the agent. Do not fixate on one archetype; roam across behavioral directions (impatience, fragmentary disclosure, skepticism, ambiguity, low domain familiarity, heavy confirmation needs, etc.) while always staying judge-valid.

validity.rule: illegal if severe_failure_rate > 0.05; rate = severe_failures / n_scored (ALL non-infra sims)
validity._comment_pruning: A severe failure can only occur in a sim the agent FAILED; successful sims are 'ok' by construction. So judge only failed sims (reward<0.999), worst-first, capped at max_failures per persona, but divide severe count by the FULL scored-sim count so the 0.05 threshold keeps its meaning.

selection.rule: exclude illegal; prefer untested; fill with valid by ascending avg_success_rate

_comment_seed: Randomly picked from the 5 existing cc_user_sim/personas; round-0 untested set.
